articles.title: Solana, Sui and Aptos wallet data targeted in TrapDoor package attack
articles.snippet: The campaign targets crypto, DeFi, AI and security developers with fake tooling packages to steal wallets, SSH keys, GitHub tokens, cloud credentials and browser data.

articles.title: Bit Digital buys $20M worth of Ethereum, expands treasury to 158K ETH
articles.snippet: The purchase pushed the Nasdaq-listed company ahead of Coinbase Global to become the fourth-largest public corporate holder of Ether, according to CoinGecko data.

articles.title: Lenovo Stock Doubles in May on AI Server Boom—Best Month in 27 Years
articles.snippet: The world's biggest PC maker surged 109% in May after AI revenue hit 38% of quarterly sales. Goldman Sachs more than doubled its target.

articles.title: Apple iOS 27 Leaks: Siri Is Being Remade to Be More Like ChatGPT
articles.snippet: Rendered illustrations published ahead of WWDC 2026 reveal a dedicated Siri app, Dynamic Island integration, and a Google Gemini backbone—the biggest overhaul to the assistant in nearly 15 years.

articles.title: Standard Chartered Reaffirms $40K Ethereum Price Target Due to DeFi Dominance
articles.snippet: Analysts compared Ethereum's current position to Amazon following the dot-com bubble burst.
